# Extracted Relationship

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ExtractedRelationship`](gmeow-ExtractedRelationship.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ExtractedRelationship>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A model-extracted relationship description between extracted-entity descriptions — the GraphRAG edge as a revisable, attributed artifact rather than a black-box triple.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ExtractedRelationship`](gmeow-ExtractedRelationship.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
